Package index

All functions

align_to_north()
Align point cloud to y axis
as_pt_cld()
Convert an object to a point cloud
boxdim()
Compute the box dimension structural complexity index for a given point cloud.
canopy_stats()
Compute canopy height statistics from a point cloud.
cci()
Compute the crown complementarity index (CCI) for two raw single tree point clouds.
clip_rect()
Clip a point cloud to an axis-aligned rectangle
clip_rect_mesh()
Clip a mesh3d object to an axis-aligned rectangle
clip_z()
Clip point cloud vertically
cloud_to_mat()
Convert tabular data to a point cloud matrix
coi()
Compute the crown overlap index (COI) for two raw single tree point clouds.
compute_coi()
Compute the crown overlap index (COI) for a vector with interaction distances.
co_2d()
Compute a projected 2D crown overlap index for two point clouds.
enl()
Compute the Effective Number of Layers (ENL) for a voxelized point cloud.
extract_dtm()
Extract digital terrain model from point cloud
extract_interaction()
Extract interaction distances between two point clouds.
extract_slope()
Extract terrain slope from a DTM mesh.
gen_sphere()
Generate an artifical voxelized point cloud of a sphere.
is_pt_cld()
Check if an object is a pt_cld
point_dist_filter()
Filter points by nearest-neighbour distance
pt_cld()
Create a point cloud object
save_to_laz()
Save cloud to a .laz file
sor()
Statistical outlier removal
voxelize()
Voxelize matrix-like point cloud objects.
z_normalize()
Normalize point cloud to digital terrain model
